source_limitation: Raw benchmark source_commit captured the surrounding checkout parent while the extraction was uncommitted. The preserved frozen snapshot matches all 53 Python files at 2e0e88d. The final shared implementation is committed at d493a41; an immutable hash of its benchmark-time dirty tree was not recorded.

hardware_qualification.scope: Qualification of the shared runtime on A100, A6000, and B300 for the 20 joint dK x Taylor-degree recipes.

gla_fused_kernel.scope: Chunked Triton GLA kernels (attention/backends/chunked_gla_triton.py) for the GLA d_K sweep recipes
gla_fused_kernel.tests: scaffolds/transformer/tests/test_gla_kernel.py (21 GPU cases) plus 49 GLA CPU tests
defects_fixed: jaxlib assembled bridge PTX with the node /usr/local/cuda ptxas; dogo CUDA 12.6 rejects Triton 3.6 PTX 8.7 (20/21 H100 cases failed). Launchers pin CUDA_HOME to the locked nvidia/cuda_nvcc (CUDA 12.9).

BF16 operands upcast in-kernel made Triton 3.6 on sm_103 lower IEEE FP32 products at TF32-level precision (12/21 B300 cases failed; mixed-case output error 4.0e-4 vs FP64, H100 1.5e-7). Operands are converted to FP32 before launch.
Extreme-decay test compared a log-decay gradient that underflows to zero by relative error; it now uses the input-gradient scale.

learned_polynomial_fused_kernel.scope: Fused unnormalized kernel with learned per-head coefficients (attention/backends/fused_learned_polynomial.py) for the learned_unnormalized_taylor recipes, degrees 1-4
learned_polynomial_fused_kernel.tests: scaffolds/transformer/tests/test_learned_polynomial_fused_attention.py (26 GPU cases) plus 46 learned-polynomial CPU tests

qk_norm_cosine_scores.scope: QK-norm cosine scores (attention/qk_norm.py): unit-normalized Q/K pre-scaled so the unchanged kernels compute exp(gamma) cos(q, k); qualified for exact softmax through cuDNN at d_K = 64 for the qk_norm_attention recipe
qk_norm_cosine_scores.tests: scaffolds/transformer/tests/test_qk_norm.py (5 GPU cases: cuDNN softmax and the fused Taylor, unnormalized, and learned-polynomial kernels on cosine operands at the 2,048-token BF16 context, including the log-scale gradient) plus 44 QK-norm CPU tests

b300.note: 12 = the 5 QK-norm gates plus test_attention.py's 7 GPU cases (cuDNN softmax control at width 64 and the blocked bf16 context)

h100.note: Not qualified: job 202156's two H100 attempts were preempted during acceptance's CPU tests before the GPU stage.

qk_norm_cosine_scores.known_limitation_encountered: job 202156 on B300 failed acceptance because its GPU stage included test_softmax_backends.py, whose width-256 cuDNN cases B300 rejects (hidden_dim > 128 with d_qk != d_v); unrelated to QK-norm, removed from the recipe's GPU stage

normalized_learned_polynomial_and_qk_nor.scope: Row-normalized attention with learned polynomial coefficients (attention/learned_polynomial.py, blocked reference only) and QK-norm cosine scores composed with the fused learned-polynomial kernel, for the qk_norm_learned_taylor recipes (degrees 1-4, d_K = 64)

source_commit.pre_launch: 1d9b30c (scaffold change; the tested tree equals the commit)

normalized_learned_polynomial_and_qk_nor.tests: scaffolds/transformer/tests/test_learned_polynomial_normalized.py (4 GPU cases: blocked normalized learned kernel at the 2,048-token BF16 context on cosine operands with an FP64 prefix comparison) plus test_qk_norm.py (5) and test_learned_polynomial_fused_attention.py (26); 673 CPU tests

pre_launch.note: jobs 202334 and 202335 failed only the new degree-1 FP64 prefix comparison at scale 8, where the signed row sums of 1 + s make the constant coefficient's gradient a difference of near-equal FP32 sums; the comparison was moved to scale 2

h100.note: first H100 qualification of QK-norm; the earlier qk_norm_attention run qualified B300 only

fused_normalized_learned_polynomial.scope: Fused row-normalized learned direct coefficients and nonnegative sum-of-squares factors; kernel correctness, full-context BF16 gradients, synthetic Transformer resume, and separately recorded update qualification.
